proofs.text: Read `tools/QA/purlin-qa-report.md`; collect the bolded backticked verdict names in the section that lists them and verify the collected list is exactly `ready`, `add a case`, `rewrite the proof`, `needs a human`, in that order. rule_text: Every entry in the review list closes with exactly one of four verdicts, `ready`, `add a case`, `rewrite the proof` and `needs a human`, and the skill names no fifth

tests.name: test_every_entry_ends_with_one_of_four_verdicts
